title: Native GPU wrapper must preserve CTest regex pipes
body: The documented native wrapper invokes cmd.exe, which treats the unquoted CTest -R expression containing | as a command separator; the combined EditorToggleUndoCapture|HudRenderCapture witness failed before CTest. The wrapper should pass arbitrary CTest arguments without cmd.exe interpreting regex metacharacters.

title: Native CMake must normalize paired WSL paths
body: Native configure received UNDERTOW_ROOT/YEROKET_ROOT through WSL path conversion and generated invalid backslash glob paths such as \wsl.localhost and C:\...\*.cs. The CMake facade should own cross-host path normalization rather than requiring a lane-side environment workaround.

title: Codegen checks must invalidate stale malformed cached emitters
body: After a forced rebuild, appflow_regen still emitted an invalid AppFlow.g.h with malformed noexcept placement, while the pinned source emitter was valid. The codegen check needs a freshness/provenance contract that rejects stale or mismatched cached generators before consumers compile.

title: GPU capture fixtures must own fresh output roots
body: CTest fixture ordering ran producers before consumers, but queue-side capture-root sanitization meant producers and consumers could silently resolve different roots or consume stale files. The fixture contract should pass one validated fresh output root to both producer and consumer and fail if required outputs were not created in the current run.
